name: hres_degradation_aware_v1
question: Does an explicit, spatially resolved estimate of anchor degradation improve six-hour interpolation from IFS HRES forecast anchors?

reliability_branch.inputs: decoder features, FiLM-modulated by the forecast-lead embedding
reliability_branch.output: per-channel, per-pixel predicted anchor error magnitude in normalized units, via softplus
reliability_branch.supervision: measured anchor error 0.5*(|x0-ERA5(t0)| + |xT-ERA5(t0+6h)|), train split only
consumers: anchor trust gate: beta_logits -= softplus(anchor_trust_gain) * (predicted_error - reference)
reliability_branch.initialisation: output bias set to softplus^-1(reference) so the predicted excess is exactly zero and both consumers are neutral; verified bit-identical to the parent on real weights at leads 0, 96 and 216 h

augcontrol_rmse.role: control: identical run without the reliability branch

promotion_rule.primary: degrade_rmse must beat augcontrol_rmse on the 2021 development index without systematic per-field regressions
promotion_rule.secondary: no loss of the full-lead gain over Linear
promotion_rule.spectral: Q850 and U850 log-shape error at tau 2 and 3 over degrees 80-180 must not worsen by more than 0.02 relative to the parent
promotion_rule.on_failure: report as a negative result; the full-lead checkpoint remains the model of record
